text:
Becca (PM): Quick post-launch sync: we've got three follow-ons from the rollout retrospective — 1) a customer-reported ranking inconsistency, 2) mobile cold-start latency that hurts trial conversion, 3) a non-blocking but noisy 5xx in the batch ingest path. Need to decide what goes into hotfix lane vs next sprint.
Tom: short take: ranking inconsistency = correctness, likely hotfix. Mobile cold-start is product activation (could be urgent). 5xx noise = infra backlog but we should monitor.
Yara: the ranking issue shows on dedicated only and is reproducible with our enterprise test set. Looks like normalization in the post-rank scorer flipped sign when empty metadata present. Filed as #RANK-198.
Ken (Eng): can you paste a minimal repro? I can probably push a small conditional guard to the scorer in <2 hours.
Yara: pasted repro snippet from logs:
```
query: "refund policy"
cands: [docA, docB]
score_before_norm: [0.42, 0.39]
score_after_norm: [-0.12, -0.09]
```
Ken (Eng): yup that's a normalization bug. I'll open PR that guards against empty meta and add unit tests. If tests pass, we can canary to pool-1.
Olga (Design): mobile cold-start: UX team ran a quick A/B, buffering the first 200ms of audio/text reduced perceived stutter and increased trial click-through by ~3%. We can ship this as a short-term mitigation in SDK.
Tom: proposal: must-fix = ranking inconsistency (customer-facing correctness), urgent = mobile cold-start mitigation (activation), backlog = batch 5xx (investigate and schedule). Anyone object?
Yara: agree. For ranking, acceptance criteria: fix merged + canary validation on customer testset showing top-3 stable = baseline or better for 95% queries. Rollout blocked until canary green.
Ken (Eng): timeline: PR in 90m, tests + canary in 4 hours. I'll tag infra for canary window.
Olga (Design): SDK mitigation: I can ship a patch that introduces `prefetch_first_chunk=true` defaulted only for mobile beta; target canary in 24h. We'll collect activation telemetry.
Tom: for batch 5xx: support-bot, can you surface recent alerts and affected pools so infra can triage?
support-bot: rolling-alerts: recent 5xx spikes on ingest-pool-4 between 02:10-02:40 UTC; 12 events, sample logs attached to ticket #INGEST-55. Owners: infra.
Yara: owners: ranking = Ken + Yara; mobile = Olga + Tom; batch 5xx = infra. I'll move ranking + mobile into the "hotfix lane" on the board and add acceptance criteria.
Ken (Eng): will include smoke `curl` check in PR description:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rank -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"q":"refund policy","cands":[...]}'
```
Tom: customer comms: if ranking not fixed in 24h, offer routing to previous scorer + 10% credit for impacted customers.
Olga (Design): noted. We'll prepare a short user-facing note describing temporary mitigation for mobile.
Yara: ok, updating the roadmap board and scheduling a triage follow-up in 12h. Thanks team.
